audit_metadata.purpose: Diagnostic investigation only - no training, no model changes
audit_metadata.scope: Re-examination of causal claims vs correlations
audit_metadata.corrections_made: Major corrections to overconfident causal attributions

gap_explanation.previous_claim: Explained by regime (4-5 W/m²) + clouds (2-3 W/m²) + reconstruction (1-2 W/m²)
gap_explanation.corrected_claim: Partially explained by plausible mechanisms, not fully quantified

claim_1_h9_h12_regime.corrected_status: Observed irradiance difference (9.7 W/m²), not quantified error contribution
claim_1_h9_h12_regime.reason_for_correction: Higher irradiance does not automatically lower absolute MAE. Actual ODD error rate (27.3%) is better in H9-H12 than rest (29.4%). Cannot show 4-5 W/m² contribution without evaluating same model on both splits.
required_for_quantification: Evaluate same model (reconstructed HGB) on both EVEN and ODD
Compute error rates in each regime for both splits
Show error difference × distribution mismatch yields 4-5 W/m²

claim_2_cloud_distribution.corrected_status: Cloud cover difference is real (p<0.001), error impact unquantified
claim_2_cloud_distribution.reason_for_correction: Statistical significance of distribution difference ≠ quantified causal impact. Did not segment by cloud regimes or compute error rate changes.
required_for_quantification: Compute MAE/error-rate within cloud bins for both splits
Show error changes similarly with cloud in both
Weight by distribution mismatch in each bin
Sum across bins to get 2-3 W/m² attribution

potential_causes: Random seed differences (sklearn HGB is stochastic)
claim_3_reconstruction_variance.artifact_limitation: Phase 10 says 'default hyperparameters' but does not specify exact values
claim_3_reconstruction_variance.recommendation: Use Phase 10's reported 26.3668 W/m² as official control. 1.58 W/m² discrepancy is UNRESOLVED.

claim_4_gap_explained.fundamental_problem: Two different models - cannot isolate regime from algorithm contribution

original_stage8_1.training_data: UNKNOWN (presumably EVEN, approved before ODD eval)

claim_4_gap_explained.required_to_decompose: Evaluate SAME model on both splits (would violate dev/test boundary)
claim_4_gap_explained.conclusion: Cannot rigorously decompose 9.82 W/m² gap into regime vs algorithm components from available artifacts

confirmed_findings.evidence: Zero missing data, zero ODD reads, 0 fold mismatches verified
GroupKFold verified, 0 mismatches across 173 EVEN origins
No future actual_SW_IN or noncausal features found

confirmed_findings.finding: Cloud cover difference (ODD higher by 3.3%, p<0.001)
H9-H12 irradiance difference (EVEN higher by 9.7 W/m², p<0.001)

confirmed_findings.evidence: KS tests p>0.36 for temperature and humidity

confirmed_findings.finding: Gap is real and measured (9.82 W/m²)
confirmed_findings.evidence: Official predictions verify 36.188657 W/m², Phase 10 reports 26.3668 W/m²

retracted_findings.reason: Showed correlation (irradiance difference) not quantified causal mechanism
Showed distribution difference not quantified error impact
Cannot explain 1.58 W/m² discrepancy from available artifacts
Regime differences are plausible but not rigorously quantified

unresolved_findings.question: What is the exact regime contribution to the gap?
unresolved_findings.why: Cannot evaluate same model on both EVEN and ODD simultaneously
unresolved_findings.would_require: Either (A) original Stage 8.1 code for EVEN evaluation, or (B) permission to evaluate reconstructed HGB on ODD

unresolved_findings.question: What is the exact algorithm contribution?
unresolved_findings.why: Original Stage 8.1 architecture and hyperparameters not available
unresolved_findings.would_require: Original training code and hyperparameter specification

unresolved_findings.question: Why does 26.3668 W/m² ≠ 24.7820 W/m²?
unresolved_findings.why: Exact hyperparameters not specified in artifacts
unresolved_findings.would_require: Phase 10 must provide exact sklearn HGB hyperparameters and random seed

unresolved_findings.question: Will EVEN candidates perform 10 W/m² worse on ODD?
unresolved_findings.honest_answer: Likely 5-10 W/m² worse, but magnitude is unquantified

established: Gap is real and measured (9.82 W/m²)
EVEN and ODD have different data distributions
not_established: Quantified causal contribution of each factor
Whether regime explains 30%, 50%, or 90% of gap

B_is_26_3668_trustworthy.answer: YES FOR RELATIVE COMPARISON, WITH CAVEATS
trustworthy_for: Comparing Candidates A vs B vs C within EVEN
not_trustworthy_for: Absolute performance claims without regime qualification
Predicting ODD improvement from EVEN gate results
B_is_26_3668_trustworthy.recommendation: Use as baseline for relative candidate comparison on EVEN only

C_is_10_wm2_penalty_justified.previous_claim: Expect ~10 W/m² gap when EVEN candidate moves to ODD
why_unjustified: 9.82 W/m² gap is between two different models/splits
Not proven to be regime-specific penalty
Claiming specific transfer rate without proper attribution is overconfident
Gap could be 100% algorithm, 100% regime, or mixed
C_is_10_wm2_penalty_justified.corrected_claim: ODD likely 5-10 W/m² worse than EVEN, magnitude unquantified

recommended_additions: Add caveat: ODD performance worse due to unquantified regime differences
Clarify: Gate results on EVEN do not predict ODD performance
Document: 1.58 W/m² discrepancy between checkpoint and independent reconstruction is UNRESOLVED

safe_aspects: EVEN control is valid for relative comparison
required_cautions: Do NOT optimize for H9-H12 (peak hours EVEN advantage)
Expect ODD to be substantially worse (likely 5-10 W/m² worse)
Monitor H9-H12 and rest-of-horizon errors separately
Do NOT claim EVEN control transfers to ODD

what_is_known: 26.3668 W/m² EVEN vs 36.188657 W/m² ODD gap is real
EVEN and ODD have detectably different data distributions
These plausibly contribute to performance difference
what_is_not_known: Exact quantitative contribution of regime vs algorithm
Whether EVEN advantage is 3, 5, or 9 W/m²
How to reliably predict ODD performance from EVEN results
Root cause of 1.58 W/m² reconstruction variance
final_verdict.scientific_recommendation: Proceed with architecture research on EVEN baseline, but maintain strict regime-awareness. Do NOT over-claim transferability to ODD. Use conservative expectations about ODD improvement.
